attributes.name: Sample preparation protocol
attributes.value: Pseudomonas fluorescens SBW25 strains were cultured in King’s B medium (KB) at 28C. Prior to experiments, cells were streaked on an agar plate from a frozen stock and incubated for 2 days. To obtain a saturated cell suspension, cells from a single colony on a plate were taken and cultured in a liquid medium with continuous shaking for 24 hours. When diluting or transferring cells, cell suspensions were agitated well with a vortex mixer for more than one minute to resolve clumps. A saturated liquid pre-culture was diluted to the required inoculum densities in a 12-well microtiter plate (TPP) and statically incubated with a stage-top incubator (ibidi) or an environmental chamber (PeCon).

attributes.name: Imaging instrument
attributes.value: Zeiss Axio Zoom V16, Zeiss Axio Imager Z2, Zeiss LSM880

attributes.name: Image acquisition parameters
attributes.value: Bacterial colonization at an air-liquid interface was captured by upright microscopes. Fluorescent microscopy was done for mScarlet and sGFP2 fluorescent proteins that were expressed by genetically-engineered bacteria.
